name: get_named_sandbox
description:
Get a named sandbox by name, including its current sandbox and routes. This only reads by default. If the sandbox is stopped and resume is true, it also creates a new sandbox instance from the most recent snapshot, which changes state.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/{name} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

name.description: Name for the sandbox. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

projectId.description: The project ID or name (required when not using OIDC token).

resume.description: Whether to automatically resume a stopped named sandbox by creating a new instance from its snapshot. Defaults to false.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
